purpose: Admit a fresh joint family when both axes retain empirical headroom, each component repairs its own axis while leaving residual headroom on the other, and their exact composition supplies incremental repair beyond both components.

conditions.E_JOINT: Exact byte composition of E_CAP, one newline, and E_GOV.

semantic_component_isolation: E_CAP contains no Governance decision rule, hidden Governance mapping, prohibition, transfer rule, or stopping rule.
E_GOV contains no Capability decision rule, hidden Capability mapping, resource-allocation rule, or execution recipe.
Cross-axis outcome changes are reported but are not independently disqualifying because a changed LLM prompt can globally replan a trajectory.
The other axis must retain residual empirical headroom under each single-component condition.

replication_design.evidence_unit: Fresh task variant. The single seed avoids treating repeated stochastic samples of one task as independent task evidence.
freshness: No user, flight, reservation, route pair, price pair, or task surface form from calibration or the small joint Gate appears in this replication.
Train and Monitor entities and surface forms are disjoint.
The predeclared seed was not used by earlier joint-family attempts.
The validated component Skill bytes are reused unchanged.

decision: ADMIT only when every threshold passes independently on Train and Monitor. Never pool splits, replace the seed, edit component Skills, or tune thresholds after rollout.
reporting: Report all four quadrant distributions by split and condition.
Report primary improvements, residual headroom, joint incremental improvements, and all cross-axis improvements and regressions.
Treat this as task-variant replication with one stochastic realization per variant; do not claim seed-level stability.
